name: Matthias
overview: In Acts 1, following the betrayal and death of Judas Iscariot, the early church, led by Peter, recognized the fulfillment of Scripture concerning Judas' fate and the necessity to replace him in the apostolic ministry. Matthias, surnamed Justus, was chosen by the disciples to take Judas' place, ensuring the continuity of the apostolic witness among the approximately one hundred and twenty believers gathered. This selection underscores the importance of divine guidance and faithfulness in maintaining the leadership established by Christ.
